label: aomic 表型/刺激提取
description: Extract and merge AOMIC phenotype tables for downstream analysis. Reads AOMIC phenotype files (Big Five personality, Raven's progressive matrices, demographics), selects columns, and optionally cross-references with imaging subject lists。 Inputs: phenotype_dir: Directory containing AOMIC phenotype CSV/TSV files (directory); imaging_ids: Path to BIDS participants.tsv or file with imaging subject IDs (file). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

parameters.label: columns
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of columns to select (default: all)
parameters.usage: 参数说明直接来自 skills/aomic-skill/scripts/extract_aomic_phenotype.py:238。平台仅转发已登记选项；默认值和取值限制见本方法定义。

parameters.label: missing-threshold
parameters.description: Drop columns with more than this fraction of missing values (default: 0.5)
parameters.usage: 参数说明直接来自 skills/aomic-skill/scripts/extract_aomic_phenotype.py:246。平台仅转发已登记选项；默认值和取值限制见本方法定义。

input_slots.description: Directory containing AOMIC phenotype CSV/TSV files. Required directory input for aomic 表型/刺激提取; bind to port phenotype_dir.

input_slots.description: Path to BIDS participants.tsv or file with imaging subject IDs. Optional file input for aomic 表型/刺激提取; bind to port imaging_ids.
